item.title: Sources: Musk chose to limit Ukraine's access to SpaceX network
item.description: Sources told CBS News that a decision by Elon Musk led to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's satellite communications network.

item.title: Pope Leo's doctors say no further treatment needed after lung cancer surgery
item.description: Dr. Luigi Carbone and Prof. Stefano Margarit said results confirmed the tumor was a localized pulmonary adenocarcinoma.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25 billion in data privacy ruling
item.description: A jury found the social media company had deceived consumers for years about its data privacy policies.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion for deceiving users about Facebook privacy
item.description: A judge ordered Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion after a jury found the company liable for deceiving users about privacy and content moderation.
